includeVolumeData.title: Include high-cardinality volume data
includeVolumeData.description: Adds ~520 extra synthetic groups, each with its own description, so the dataset holds more than 500 distinct resource descriptions. Use it to exercise the matrix wizard's paged/searchable attribute values on a test environment. Leave off for the normal demo.

includeRealismData.title: Include the realism slice (larger, messier company)
includeRealismData.description: Adds ~600 staff across ten departments and ~55 teams, with careers (people who moved department and kept the old access), guests, leavers who were never cleaned up, accounts in several systems linked into one identity, ~180 groups in naming families, nested groups, business roles that grant groups and application roles, and an attestation campaign. Built for measuring reports and the chat assistant against questions that have more than one possible answer. Leave off for the normal demo.
